notes: Written from the guide's 'Game plan by turn' and 'Playbook seeds'.

Every number here is an inference (review M5a-09): the guide gives the direction, not the value. weights, faceBias, counterAggression, cardValue and bias sizes were set by reasoning and have not been tuned on their own.

Bias sizes were chosen so the planted game-plan tests pass; ai/test/game-plan-g2.test.ts runs every seed with the biases off too, and lists the seeds that pass only because a bias encodes the guide's line.
Citations ('cite', 'citeSource') are what 'Why?' shows when a move follows the line; only biases whose condition is public carry one.
goFirst false: strategy-concepts §10 [S17] says the general default is to go second, and the guide gives no seat advice for this board deck.
cardValue: the Giants (cost-12+ Characters) the guide builds the deck around, and Luffy OP17-093 (Rush, replays a Giant) [SH-BLU].
weights.board 1.15 and faceBias 0.95/1.0/1.05: 'a board deck of cheap Blockers that also attack' [SH-BLU]; inference.
mulligan: the guide's keepable hand (inference): Rodo or Gerd plus Usopp, Sanji, Zoro or Nami OP17-086.
seed 2 is two biases: a play only while a cost-12+ Character is out, and the attack with Luffy that turn.

biases.cite: Its guide: land a cheap Giant early; it is a Blocker at once and switches on every cost-12 card.
Its guide: this Luffy has Rush only with a cost-12+ Character out, so he waits for one.
Its guide: this Luffy attacks the turn he lands.
Its guide: Luffy's On Play replays a cheap Giant from the trash.
Its guide: keep more than one Giant out.

assertions.text: Has a cost-12+ Character on the field by the end of T2.
Plays Luffy OP17-093 only while a cost-12+ Character is on the field, and attacks with him that turn.
Uses Luffy's On Play to replay a Rodo or Gerd when one is in the trash.
Keeps two or more cost-12+ Characters on the field from T4.
